caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a straw or woven seat. The chair has a reddish-brown color with wood grain detailing and features two horizontal slats in the backrest, one of which has a yellow ornamental design in the center. The legs and stretchers of the chair are rounded and turned, with some yellow decorative rings near the joints. The seat appears golden yellow, indicating a straw or woven cane construction. The chair is centered on a plain, off-white background with a faint shadow falling behind and to the right of its legs. There are no additional objects or features in the composition aside from the chair itself.
title: Rush Bottom Chair
